Decision: Neon Postgres migration to canonical financial store
Rationale: Neon is the accepted transactional financial store. Active dual-write, shadow reads, financial backfill, and daily fail-closed parity are the safe path from today’s Sheets/Redis operating state to Postgres canonical accounting and a read-only Sheets reporting projection.
Next Step: Keep PG_DUAL_WRITE enabled only while parity is clean; complete 30 days of reconciled parity, crash-injection, and restore evidence before the separately reviewed canonical-read cutover.
